summary: Iter 41: full backend + UI smoke of the Bookings Calendar, Weekly Digest cron, and Paid Members Area on Northwind Roofing (app_6663b5de0007, token pv_15f7e07b2d724b452e2a). 16/16 pytest cases pass. UI: Bookings tab present on the converted tenant; calendar renders 24h x 7-day grid with view toggles (day/week/month), prev/today/next, three booking blocks including the two clashing 10:00 blocks on today (Today Tina + Clash Chris) styled red, and the header shows data-testid=clash-warning ('double-booked'). Booking form opens from New Booking with all 8 booking-field-* controls plus notify checkbox and save button. Clicking an existing block opens booking-details with edit / cancel / cancel-quiet buttons. ProSettings shows the digest-card (enabled, hour, recipients, test, preview) and the paid-area-card (enabled, mode-one_time/subscription, price, currency, and 4 paid-page-* checkboxes). Anonymous /api/site/{token}/page/services correctly returns {paid:true, requires_payment:true} with no blocks; disabling the paid area flips it back to public content immediately and re-enabling restores the paywall. Paywall checkout returns a checkout.stripe.com URL and creates a pending payment_transactions row. Cron endpoint enforces bearer secret (401 without / with wrong, 200 with correct). Site-member JWT is properly rejected by /api/apps/* endpoints.

issues: React hydration warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>' emitted from ProSettings.jsx line 55 (digest-hour select). Appears to be caused by the visual editor injecting a <span> wrapper into each <option>. Harmless in production build but pollutes the console. Consider stripping the wrapper for <option> elements or moving to a shadcn Select.

action_items: Optional: silence the <option><span> hydration warning inside ProSettings digest-hour <select>.

Optional: the backend test_duration_clamp leaves a TEST_clamp booking on 2026-09-09 09:00 (edit endpoint's date parameter is Optional so it can't be moved by the fixture). Add a cleanup path or accept the leak — non-blocking.
critical_code_review_comments: pro_features.paywall_status uses meta.get('user_id') OR rec.get('user_id') as the fallback site_user_id — meta only contains site_user_id, so the fallback path (rec.user_id) works because we store site_user_id there, but the variable naming is misleading. Consider standardising on site_user_id everywhere.
cron/weekly-digest correctly uses hmac.compare_digest and returns immediately after enqueue via BackgroundTasks — matches the acknowledge-fast contract.

paid_settings clears the 'paid' flag on ALL pages then re-sets it only for the selected page_ids. This is correct for the 'toggle off = instant public' requirement; verified in the live test (services flipped from requires_payment to public and back).
BookingsCalendar polls every 8s — acceptable for 'live sync ~10s'. No SSE fallback needed for this iteration.

success_rate.frontend: 100% smoke — every required data-testid resolves to exactly 1 element and clash detection displays red blocks + double-booked banner
